leadText:
{{AnimePokémonInfobox

Piplup was referenced by Ash in Going for the Gold!, when he and his friends met a troop of many Piplup at the . Ash recalled that Dawn's Piplup had been rather prideful and stubborn.
Starting in Pokémon DP: Battle Dimension, Dawn keeps Piplup out of his Poké Ball, apart from rare cases like in Pokémon Contests.
The of Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl shows Dawn's Piplup coming out of his with a trail of stars behind him. However, Dawn did not use a Star Seal with Piplup's Poké Ball until Yes in Dee Dee, It's Dawn!, three seasons later.
Piplup was featured in a promotional C-Gear skin alongside Brock's Croagunk in Japan to celebrate the animated specials featuring and . This Piplup was later distributed as event Pokémon for Japanese games to commemorate his appearance in Best Wishes! Season 2.
Dawn's Piplup has been given a redesign since his return in Nightfall? Nightmares!, now having blue eyes like in the games, instead of having black eyes as his depiction from and .
